content.text: The redline validated. Submitting the finding.

input.quote: MSL will provide replacement value insurance coverage for consigned Products. IBM will be named as a joint insured with respect to consigned Products for its interest.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no vendor insurance covenant. The only insurance references are narrow and property-specific: SOW 13.1(b) requires MSL to carry replacement-value cover for IBM consigned Products (with IBM as joint insured); SOW 21.2 obliges IBM (not MSL) to insure IBM-owned tooling; Loan Agreement Section 8 relieves MSL of risk of loss on Loaned Items; and 10.0 defers premises terms to a separate Lease of Premises Agreement not before us. None of these provide commercial general liability, professional liability (E&O), cyber/privacy or workers' compensation cover, so the document fails even the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M). This matters here because MSL occupies IBM premises, holds IBM and IBM-customer consigned inventory, and accesses IBM applications, networks and customer integration data under SOW 24.1 — squarely the exposure the rule targets. Redline inserts a new Section 16.22 in the General section at the preferred limits (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request), expressly preserving the existing consigned-Products cover, with the fallback limits offered in the comment.

ops.text:
16.22 Insurance

MSL shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: (a) commercial general liability insurance of not less than U.S. $1,000,000 per occurrence and U.S. $2,000,000 in the aggregate; (b) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than U.S. $2,000,000; (c) where MSL processes, stores or has access to IBM or IBM customer data, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than U.S. $5,000,000; and (d) workers' compensation and employer's liability insurance as required by applicable law. Such coverage is in addition to the replacement value insurance for consigned Products required under the Statement of Work. MSL shall provide IBM with certificates of insurance upon request.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a standard insurance covenant, as MSL occupies IBM premises, holds IBM consigned inventory and accesses IBM systems and customer data, and the Agreement currently requires only replacement-value cover for consigned Products. Our playbook position is CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M and cyber USD 5M with certificates on request; we can work with E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M if MSL's existing programme is closer to that level.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 16.22 requiring MSL to carry commercial general liability, professional liability, cyber and workers' compensation insurance, with certificates on request.
